$comment: First consumer profile (plans/01-architecture.md §4): @m3e/web ⋈ the Material 3 Design Kit. fileKey/kitVersionTag pin the Figma side per architecture §3 item 6 — node-ids anchor within THIS kit version; refresh both together when the export is re-extracted, never independently. Component keys are explicitly NOT here (they live in profiles/m3-kit/keys.<fileKey>.json, a per-fileKey cache — evidence #5). kitVersionTag is passed through verbatim from the checked-in figma-export fixture's meta.kitVersionTag (test/fixtures/build-m3-kit-fixture.mjs) — a placeholder until a real extraction session (Plan A3 runbook) stamps a dated tag. figmaExportPath points at the A2/A3 fixture, checked in; point it at a fresh extraction (extract/README.md) once the kit is re-pulled — re-running `match` after that refresh regenerates auto-* entries but never touches human/confirmed ones (merge.mjs). emitters (task B2): each entry is either the literal string "html-label" (the built-in emitter) or a repo-root-relative path to a profile-local ES module dynamically imported by src/emit/run.mjs (e.g. "profiles/m3-kit/emitters/elm.mjs", B3's Elm emitter — not created yet, so only "html-label" is listed here for now).
name: m3-kit

cem.$comment: M3.a: manifestPath now points at elm-cem's own canonical facts bundle Face B (docs/facts-bundle/schema.json) for elm-m3e's @m3e/web 2.7.6 — the same input elm-m3e itself generates from — instead of a vendored raw-manifest + .d.ts copy this repo parsed independently. src/ingest/cem.mjs's loadCem() reads Face B directly; there is no dtsDir to configure anymore (Face B is already .d.ts-resolved).

htmlLabel.$comment: Task B1's minimal config for src/emit/html-label.mjs's underlying `emitEntry`/`emitConfirmed` functions — kept separate from `emitters` (which just lists WHICH emitters run, task B2) since this is html-label's OWN per-profile config, read via ctx.profile.htmlLabel by the `emitter` export's ctx-to-config adapter (src/emit/html-label.mjs). imports: the one m3-kit needs live-proven 2026-07-10 (evidence #1). iconPlaceholder: fallback glyph baked into a slotted <m3e-icon> when a boolean slot prop has no mapped INSTANCE_SWAP counterpart (not exercised by m3e-button, whose 'Icon' prop IS mapped, but kept for other components/profiles).

elm.$comment: M3.a: config for profiles/m3-kit/emitters/elm.mjs. elmSurface (decision D5) selects which of the elm-cem facts bundle Face C's (profiles/m3-kit/facts/elm-api-facts.json) surfaceKeys the Elm snippets target: "top" (default, the strict per-component ctor surface M3e.Component.<Name>.component), "raw", "html", "record", or "build". All module/setter/token names come from that bundle (emitted by elm-cem itself when it generates elm-m3e), never from this file. textSeam names the module whose `.text` helper renders text content. CORRECTED 2026-08-17 (Stream 2, docs/plans/2026-08-17-stream2-cc-elm-naming-reconciliation.md): the prior value "Kit" rested on a now-false premise — the current elm-m3e DOES export a text helper (`text` on the `M3e` barrel, packages/elm-m3e/src/M3e.elm; shipped in jackhp95/elm-m3e-components) and its own examples (config/examples.generated.json) call `M3e.text` 1150× and `Kit.text` zero times. `Kit` is not a real module, so every snippet using it failed the CC→Elm reference gate. Seam is now `M3e` (i.e. `M3e.text "..."`), verified against the library's exposing list AND its example corpus. Override only if a consuming project's userland seam module is named differently.
elm.$comment_seams: htmlSeam/attrSeam/attrSeamFn name the seams for plain HTML scaffolding that carries multiple children — a right-aligned `<div slot="actions">` action row, or a trailing `<span>` holding text + a control. CORRECTED 2026-08-17 (Stream 2, same reconciliation as textSeam): the prior `attrSeam: "Native"` named a module that does not exist in the current elm-m3e (the CC→Elm reference gate flagged it). The real foundation is the vendored TypedHtml: `htmlSeam TypedHtml` (real — `TypedHtml.div`/`TypedHtml.span`) and custom attributes via `TypedHtml.Unsafe.Attributes.customAttribute "k" "v"` (packages/elm-m3e/docs/vendor/elm-foundation/TypedHtml/Unsafe/Attributes.elm; the exact spelling config/examples.generated.json uses, 521×). attrSeamFn is the function name on the attr seam (the helper is `customAttribute`, not `attribute`). Override only if a consuming project's HTML seam modules are named differently.
elm.$comment_expectedBrand: Phase 1.2 (plans/2026-08-17-figma-elm-config-integration-design.md): the brand name facts/elm-api-facts.json's provenance.brand.name is expected to carry — asserted by scripts/check-facts.mjs (pnpm check:facts) so a bundle copied from the wrong brand fails loud instead of silently mis-emitting. Optional field; a profile with no Elm emitter can omit it.
